822087706aa200b89f9c27cf9afa347399bf45ec.sourceText: True会创建`slam_toolbox/save_map`服务，并订阅地图；收到地图后，服务调用才会触发二维图片及YAML的保存。没有地图时会报告无法保存，True本身不会定时落盘。[MapSaver实现（2.6.10）](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/map_saver.cpp)
822087706aa200b89f9c27cf9afa347399bf45ec.translatedText: True creates the`slam_toolbox/save_map`service and subscribes to the map; only after the map is received will the service call trigger the saving of the 2D image and YAML\. When there is no map, it will report that saving is not possible, and True itself does not periodically persist to disk\.[MapSaver implementation (2\.6\.10)](https://github.com/SteveMacenski/slam_toolbox/blob/2.6.10/src/map_saver.cpp)
